name: Matsuno Juushimatsu
source: The fifth brother. Easily the most hyperactive of the siblings, Juushimatsu is enthusiastic about baseball and often exhibits crazed behavior, sometimes even defying the laws of reality. His distinguishing features as his crazed eyes, wide open mouth, and a single cowlick compared to the other siblings' two. He often dresses in yellow.
